title: Community Beastmen ALL versions (actually up-to-date, Seriously)
author: DeHess
description:
sorry for the incoming wall of caps lock, just some very important infos that everyone needs to see:

THIS IS THE MOST UP-TO-DATE VERSION OF COMMUNITY BEASTMEN. CHECK THE DATE IF YOU'RE NOT SURE. ALL OTHER MODS ON LOVERSLAB THAT HAVE COMMUNITY BEASTMEN IN THEIR NAME ARE OUT OF DATE.

THIS IS THE SAME FILE THAT CAN BE FOUND ON STEAM. IF IT ISN'T, THAT IS BECAUSE IT HASN'T YET BEEN UPLOADED TO STEAM, IT WILL BE IN THE NEXT 24 HOURS OR SO.

If you're playing as Beastmen: Use new_community_beastmen:

If you're playing any other faction: use community_beastmen_light (NOT on steam):

To install, yeet it into your data folder and place it high up in your Load Order

Incompatibilities (All versions)

- All other animation mods

- custom matched animation mods

- Complete Warmaidens collection ( use the seperate faction packs instead )

Incompatibilites (Main Version, if you're using the lite version these are ok)

- Victory Condition Overhaul

- Slaanesh Vassals

- Recruit Defeated Legendary Lords

- complete overhauls, like SFO etc.

- In general, I suggest you clear out your modlist of mods you dont really need before starting a playthrough. It will reduce the risk of bugs

If you're confused why it says updated on xyz, and I claimed that there was an update since then on discord, dont be confused. The file you download here just holds the links to the actual files. Loverslab doesn't know when I update a file there.

Other links:
